Hi Ana, I'm sorry, but I can't pay the credit out by bank transfer. Under our policy, late-delivery credit is never paid out in cash. It goes to your account instead.

NW1001 was an Express shipment promised by 2026-11-03 and delivered on 2026-11-05. That makes it late, so you're due a 100% credit of the shipping fee. The credit is applied to your account within 7 days. The exception is a delay caused by severe weather or by an incorrect address, which isn't eligible for credit.
